scientific_question: Can a causal history-only RGB student predict a human-envelope-conditioned short-horizon traversability field that improves parent-event utility over the incumbent under the same device budget?
causal_difference_from_closed_ustrf: theta distance height body head dynamic and uncertainty are inherited USTRF primitives rather than novelty claims
the action-agnostic field evaluates all candidate directions and does not infer route intent from RGB
a history-only RGB student explicitly predicts short-future layered cells and must beat current-only direct baselines
representation evaluation precedes and is isolated from the action policy

event_identity_contract.identity_authority_rule: Keys must be derived and independently verified from source-native capture inventory; candidate event, session, or source aliases cannot create new units.
event_identity_contract.overlap_rule: Temporal overlap or shared raw-capture ancestry is resolved before outcome; overlapping derivatives of one natural event count once across every arm and stratum.

promotion_contract.source_adapter_rule: Arm-specific source adapters are allowed only when frozen before outcome and counted as part of the candidate system.
promotion_contract.denominator_rule: Every pre-admitted parent event, decision-required tick, passed-or-clear opportunity, active exposure interval, device attempt, and required field cell remains in its pre-frozen metric denominator; candidate UNKNOWN, abstention, timeout, invalid, or missing output cannot remove a unit.

guardrail_denominator_rules.false_alert_parent_events_per_active_min: All pre-admitted negative/non-critical active exposure time is retained for every arm.
guardrail_denominator_rules.wrong_direction_recommendation_rate: All pre-admitted direction-required decision ticks are retained; abstention, missing, and invalid outputs use a pre-frozen error/censoring score rather than disappearing.
guardrail_denominator_rules.passed_or_clear_correctness: All pre-admitted passed-or-clear opportunities are retained; no-output is scored by a pre-frozen missing rule.
guardrail_denominator_rules.unknown_coverage_and_unknown_to_safe_err: All required field cells and decision ticks are retained, including missing field output.
guardrail_denominator_rules.minimum_source_or_session_result: Every source/session group retains all pre-admitted natural parent events after ancestry deduplication.
guardrail_denominator_rules.device_cost: Every scheduled device inference attempt is retained; timeout, crash, invalid output, and thermal abort use pre-frozen worst-case or failure scoring.

decision_rule: at least one co-primary clears a pre-frozen superiority margin
the other co-primary and every guardrail clear pre-frozen non-inferiority or upper bounds
the increment replicates on new source ancestry and independent parent events; a new evidence version on the same source is regression only
an independent validator recomputes the terminal without importing candidate decision code
h3_authorization_prerequisites: precision or power justified minimum independent source ancestry and parent-event counts are frozen
positive negative and critical parent-event stratum minimums are frozen and met after source-native ancestry deduplication
superiority and non-inferiority use pre-frozen confidence bounds or an equivalent bounded uncertainty rule
missed critical events retain a pre-frozen worst-case or censoring value in lead-time evaluation
incumbent model adapter kernel cohort protocol and validator identities are hash bound

prohibited_claims: world model without action-conditioned state transition or rollout
teacher proxy is human risk truth
